title: App Builder Asset Decisions
description: Per-asset publication decisions made by a person after ingestion. Approving a source is not approving every asset derived from it: a public page can be read for what it says without its photographs becoming republishable, so each asset carries its own decision and an approval that outruns its source's rights needs an explicit rights declaration for that asset alone. Decisions live beside the knowledge pack rather than inside it, so the pack stays derived truth about sources and composition stays a pure function of its inputs.

decision.description: approve makes the asset publishable; reject records that it was considered and turned down; do-not-use blocks it outright. Returning an asset to its derived state removes its decision rather than recording another one.

rightsDeclaration.description: Required to approve an asset whose source is not itself approved for use. It is a statement about this asset, made once, and never inferred from the asset being publicly visible.

focalPoint.description: Where the subject is, in normalised coordinates, so crops are computed around it instead of guessed by an attention heuristic. Recorded durably: re-ingesting the source regenerates the derived files, and the recorded point is re-applied rather than lost.

cropReview.description: Smart crops are generated by an attention heuristic and ship only once someone has looked at them. Pending withholds the cropped variants; the full image still publishes.

supersededBy.description: The asset that replaced this one. Recorded on the asset being retired so an audit of what a page shows can follow the chain back, rather than finding a rejected picture with no explanation.

replaces.description: The asset this one was uploaded to replace. It records lineage only: a replacement is a different photograph, so it never inherits the retired asset's rights declaration, crop review or focal point.

effect.description: What the decision actually did, resolved when it was made, so the record can be audited without re-deriving the rules that produced it.
